description: This file declares the interface ImageWritePlatformService, which provides methods for saving, updating, and deleting images related to entities, with security annotations controlling access based on user authorities.

classes.name: ImageWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface defining methods for image management operations with security constraints.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateImage
methods.description: Saves or updates an image for an entity, identified by entity name and ID, with an image file stream.

methods.name: saveOrUpdateImage
methods.description: Saves or updates an image for an entity using a Base64 encoded image object.

methods.name: deleteImage
methods.description: Deletes an image associated with an entity by name and ID.
